name: sat_tube_bass
description: Tube saturation for bass DI — even harmonics add warmth and audibility on small speakers
notes: Asymmetry 0.5 adds even harmonics (2nd harmonic = one octave above the note, 4th = two octaves above). Drive 0.2 is conservative — enough to fill out the mid-range presence without audible distortion. 60% wet preserves the clean DI attack. Use after apply_eq and apply_compression, before apply_amp if amp simulation is also used.
